test-header-thread-1.content:
<content thesys="true">{
  "component": {
    "component": "Card",
    "props": {
      "children": [
        {
          "component": "CardHeader",
          "props": {
            "title": "Header Testing",
            "subtitle": "Demonstrating different header configurations"
          }
        },
        {
          "component": "TextContent",
          "props": {
            "textMarkdown": "## Different Header Examples\n\nHere are various ways to implement headers in your UI:\n\n### Basic Header\n- Simple title with optional subtitle\n- Clean and straightforward presentation\n\n### Header with Actions\n- Includes action buttons for user interaction\n- Commonly used for editable content sections\n\n### Header Variants\n- Can be styled with different visual treatments\n- Supports icons and additional metadata\n\n**Note:** Headers help organize content and provide clear section boundaries in your interface."
          }
        },
        {
          "component": "Accordion",
          "props": {
            "children": [
              {
                "value": "basic",
                "variant": "card",
                "trigger": {
                  "text": "Basic Header Example"
                },
                "content": [
                  {
                    "component": "CardHeader",
                    "props": {
                      "title": "Simple Header",
                      "subtitle": "This is a basic header with title and subtitle"
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "component": "TextContent",
                    "props": {
                      "textMarkdown": "This demonstrates a clean, minimal header approach perfect for most content sections."
                    }
                  }
                ]
              },
              {
                "value": "actions",
                "variant": "card",
                "trigger": {
                  "text": "Header with Actions"
                },
                "content": [
                  {
                    "component": "CardHeader",
                    "props": {
                      "title": "Interactive Header",
                      "subtitle": "Header with action buttons",
                      "actions": [
                        {
                          "component": "Button",
                          "props": {
                            "children": "Edit",
                            "name": "edit_header",
                            "variant": "secondary",
                            "size": "small"
                          }
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "component": "TextContent",
                    "props": {
                      "textMarkdown": "This header includes action buttons that users can interact with, perfect for editable content areas."
                    }
                  }
                ]
              }
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "error": null
}</content>
